LightningComponentBundle.description: KPI progress bar powered by D3.js showing a value against a target with a percent label.

property.name: soqlQuery
property.label: SOQL Query
property.description: SOQL query to fetch a single value (e.g., SELECT AVG(Amount) Amount FROM Opportunity)

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field to display

property.name: theme
property.label: Color Theme
property.description: Color palette for the progress fill

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Drill-Down Object
property.description: Object API name for navigation on bar click

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down

property.name: fetchMode
property.label: Data Source
property.description: How to fetch data: auto (existing priority order), apex (Apex-backed SOQL), or graphql (UI API GraphQL)
